title:
Review this change and write REVIEW.md with one finding per line as `<file>:<line>: <severity>: <comment>` (severity is high, medium or low). Do not modify any other file.

```diff
--- a/app/cache.py
+++ b/app/cache.py
@@ -1,8 +1,14 @@
 import json
 
 
-def load(path):
-    with open(path) as f:
-        return json.load(f)
+def load(path, seen=[]):
+    try:
+        with open(path) as f:
+            data = json.load(f)
+    except Exception:
+        pass
+    seen.append(path)
+    return data
```
verify_cmd:
python -c 'import pathlib, re
text = pathlib.Path("REVIEW.md").read_text()
rows = [m.group(4) for m in (re.match(r"\s*[-*]?\s*`?(app/cache\.py):(\d+)`?:\s*(high|medium|low):\s*(.+)", l, re.I) for l in text.splitlines()) if m]
assert len(rows) >= 2, "expected at least two findings in the required format"
joined = " ".join(rows)
assert re.search(r"swallow|bare|broad|except|unbound|undefined|NameError|UnboundLocal", joined, re.I), "swallowed exception not reported"
assert re.search(r"mutable|default arg|shared (list|state)|seen=\[\]", joined, re.I), "mutable default not reported"'
